sources.title: Alibaba Unveils Qwen3.8-Max: Its Largest and Most Capable Flagship Model to Date
sources.evidence: August 3, 2026 launch announcement explicitly describes API-available Qwen3.8-Max as a sparse MoE with hybrid attention, 2.4 trillion total parameters, 95 billion activated parameters, and up to one million context tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max model overview
sources.evidence: Current exact endpoint page describes a 2.4-trillion-parameter MoE for coding, professional work and long-horizon tasks. It lists image, text and video input, text output, function calling, thinking examples and 1M context.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B official model card
sources.evidence: The downloadable text-generation checkpoint is distinct: the card calls hosted Qwen3.8-Max the official version based on it with additional vision input, non-thinking support, 1M default context and built-in tools. Its own architecture details and nominal language-model counts are not treated as complete hosted-model tensor counts.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max Update Notice
sources.evidence: The qwen3.8-max endpoint was upgraded on September 5, 2026 to the qwen3.8-max-0902 snapshot dated September 2, retaining 1M context, thinking and the tool ecosystem.

sources.title: Model releases
sources.evidence: Dates qwen3.8-max to August 3, 2026, separately lists qwen3.8-max-0902 on September 2 and US regional availability on October 8. Describes the August launch as native vision-language MoE with 2.4T parameters and hybrid thinking.

sources.title: Visual understanding models
sources.evidence: The exact qwen3.8-max row documents text/image/video input, text output, 1M context and function calling. Audio understanding is assigned to the separate Omni model.

sources.title: PDF understanding
sources.evidence: Explicitly lists qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-max-0902 as supporting PDF input through Chat Completions and DashScope, but not through Responses.

sources.title: Thinking
sources.evidence: Lists qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-max-0902 as hybrid models with thinking enabled by default; separately lists qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b as thinking-only.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max License in the Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B repository
sources.evidence: The open checkpoint has a custom Qwen3.8-Max License covering its supplied weights and related artifacts. The file does not establish that the complete hosted multimodal Max/0902 weights are the same licensed artifact.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max-Preview announcement
sources.evidence: A secondary preview-history page linked this announcement for July 19, 2026. Direct retrieval returned 403, so its date and content are not used to override the explicit August 3 non-preview launch.

sources.title: Models.dev Qwen3.8 Max record
sources.evidence: Original catalog source followed as a discovery lead; its open_weights=false assertion is not accepted as primary evidence.

name.note: Catalog display spacing represents the official Qwen3.8-Max name.

developer.note: Alibaba's own announcement identifies this as its model.

release_date.note: Earliest verified primary release of the non-preview qwen3.8-max identifier. The earlier Max-Preview is separate; its linked X announcement was inaccessible. September snapshot and October US rollout do not replace the initial release date.

open_weights.note: The open text-only checkpoint is verified, but equivalence to the complete hosted multimodal model, currently mapped to 0902, is not. No explicit primary closed-weight statement was located; API hosting alone does not establish false. Clear the baseline assertion.

license.note: The similarly named custom checkpoint license cannot be assigned to the hosted model without a verified artifact mapping. This is an identity limitation, not a claim that the open checkpoint lacks a license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-reported hosted-model total: 2.4 trillion = 2400 billion. Direct Max disclosure, not a derived checkpoint tensor total or a sum inferred from the open text-only card.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal activated count directly disclosed for Qwen3.8-Max at launch. This is not a recomputation from checkpoint expert counts; a separate vision-path activation breakdown is not disclosed.

architecture.note: Exact hosted-model sources explicitly state sparse MoE plus hybrid attention. Do not import the open checkpoint's layer or expert layout as a verified complete hosted configuration.

context_window.note: Hosted context is advertised as 1M tokens. This differs from the open checkpoint's 262144 native positions; input and output limits are separate.

modalities.note: All listed inputs supported. PDF is an API document-input capability limited to Chat Completions/DashScope; video support does not establish audio input.

reasoning.note: Hosted Max and current 0902 target support toggleable thinking, enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Explicit function calling and built-in tool support.

description.value: Qwen3.8 model with 2.4 trillion nominal parameters, sparse MoE architecture, a one-million-token context, and text, image, video and PDF input.
description.note: Combines direct nominal-count disclosure with documented hosted capabilities; omits performance claims.

patch.notes: Alibaba directly reports nominal 2.4T total / 95B active for hosted Qwen3.8-Max, with sparse MoE and hybrid attention; these are not exact checkpoint tensor counts. Since September 5, 2026 the endpoint maps to qwen3.8-max-0902; August 3 remains the original non-preview release. The open Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B checkpoint is text-only and the hosted model adds vision and non-thinking support; complete hosted-weight availability and license mapping remain unverified. PDF input is supported through Chat Completions/DashScope, not Responses. API callability was not tested.

Official open checkpoint and hosted model distinction

patch.description: Qwen3.8 model with 2.4 trillion nominal parameters, sparse MoE architecture, a one-million-token context, and text, image, video and PDF input.

summary: Verified all capability and identity fields except complete hosted-weight availability and license mapping. Fill nominal total/active parameters with 2400/95 and architecture with moe from explicit hosted-model primary disclosure; clear unsupported open_weights=false. Preserve August 3 release and 1M multimodal specification, while documenting September 5 alias upgrade and the distinct open text-only checkpoint.
